title: Concurrent instances within per-machine limits
goal: Several instances at once within CPU, memory and model-slot limits per machine; the same pilot can run two jobs, each in its own instance
acceptance: Per-machine limits as configuration; a job over the limit waits in the queue, it is not refused silently
Two jobs of one pilot run in two instances with separate state
Tests for limits, queueing and same-pilot concurrency
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
validation: Unit and join tests; npm test
escalation: New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-13 at 0.25x from node tools/work-items.mjs calibrate (median 0.25x over 16 closed steps since 2026-11-12).
